strategist.description: Turns a research question into a detailed paper outline with verifiable [CLAIM] statements.

literature-scout.description: Generates precise search queries and a fill-in template for finding academic papers on a topic.

analyst.description: Extracts every factual claim from an academic paper for use in evidence databases.

claim-verifier.description: Checks whether a single in-text citation genuinely supports the claim it is attached to.

drafter.description: Writes paper sections using the outline and verified evidence from the evidence database.

reviewer.description: Peer-reviews draft paper sections for logic, flow, evidence support, and writing quality.
